results.title: Orville Peck Overdosed, Went to Rehab, Made New Album ‘Mule’
results.description: Orville Peck thinks often about what would have happened if he died that night in 2023 of a self-inflicted overdose, heartbroken and hopeless at his New York City hotel. It was the evening before he was supposed to play to a sold-out crowd at the Theater at Madison Square Garden, kicking off his Bronco run [...] The post Orville Peck Overdosed, Went to Rehab, Made New Album ‘Mule’ appeared first on CBNC .
